postgresql.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
postgresql.topology: one container on the same machine, data on a Docker volume, port published on 127.0.0.1

proudauth.build: identity-server, identity-worker, identity-cli and identity-bench built from the checkout (GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local go build -mod=readonly -buildvcs=false -trimpath)
proudauth.processes: one identity-server and one identity-worker on the host, plain HTTP on 127.0.0.1

metadata_fetch.receiver: identity-bench metadata-receiver on the same host
metadata_fetch.tls: HTTPS with explicit ephemeral CA; no verification bypass
metadata_fetch.private_material: TLS/signing keys only in receiver memory; assertions/tokens only in benchmark memory; public CA in disposable work directory
